messages:
marta: Quick flag — bringing up LexNorm-13B. Conversion finished but runtime throws an IndexError in our fused attention path. Posting minimal repro and logs.

kevin: Paste the exact conversion command and tokenizer config?

marta: command we used:
```
python tools/convert_model.py --src hf/lexnorm-13b --dst redwood/lexnorm-13b --tokenizer-norm nfkc --emit-vocab vocab_red.json
```
and tokenizer.json had "apply_norm": true. conversion logs:
```
orig token: "\uFB01" -> id 50234
post-dedupe id: 49805
vocab_size (deduped): 49800
rotary apply head0 idx 49805 -> anglewrap -> kvcache idx 49805 >= vocab_size
Traceback (most recent call last): IndexError: KV cache index out of range
```

lucy: that smells like we normalized at tokenizer build *and* in the vocab builder; double normalization can remap precomposed/decomposed sequences and change id assignments.

raj: also verify the head/dim layout. some of our kernels assume headwise contiguous layout; if conversion permuted head ordering it could cause per-head kvcache misaddressing.

marta: confirmed vocabbuilder had a safety pass: normalize_nfkc=true. so same input string gets different ids depending on which codepath ran. quick encode-check:
```
>>> t1 = tok.encode("cafe\u0301")
>>> t2 = tok_nfkc.encode("caf\u00e9")
>>> t1 == t2
False
```

kevin: That will break any code that assumes stable token->embedding index across conversion and runtime (we rely on token id alignment for cached prefix slots in the fused attention fast-path). If ids shift, kvcache lookups point at wrong memory and can index past vocab.

ci-bot: Created INF-3245: "lexnorm: double-normalize during conversion -> token id reindex -> rotary/kvcache OOB" <https://tracker/internal/INF-3245>

lucy: Short-term mitigations:
- Add assertion post-conversion: sample canonical seed set (100 unicode variants) -> token ids must match runtime tokenizer with same norm settings.
- Forbid vocabbuilder normalize if tokenizer.apply_norm is true.
- Add CI smoke: encode->decode parity for canonical seeds.

marta: Also going to run quantization bisect (fp16 -> int8 -> int4). Preliminary: int4 makes the symptom worse because misaddressed embeddings produce stronger logit drift.

raj: Add an integration test: run a 2k-token dialogue through hosted runtime and assert top-1 token match across conversion variants; if mismatch > 1e-3 or topk disagreement > 3 tokens, fail. That will catch both reindex and head-permute regressions.

kevin: For a quick patch I can remove vocabbuilder normalizer and produce a pinned vocab mapping JSON (stable ids). If that passes your smoke, we can roll a hotfix.

marta: Please do. I'll try with pinned vocab and re-run a 50-prompt regression suite. ETA ~2h. I'll post diff of eval metrics + logs to INF-3245. Ping me if you want the conversion logs.

lucy: Add a short onboarding note: "conversion: only normalize in tokenizer step; ensure canonical-id-seed check; run headwise perm + kv cache smoke" to model-onboarding checklist.

marta: Thanks — will update the ticket and include the quant bisect charts. If patch looks good we'll release a conversion script update and a CI gate.
